current_question.question_en: Which resolutions approved the CRs that modify spec 38.331 (approval trace)?
current_question.cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.331'}) RETURN r.resolutionId, cr.tdocNumber ORDER BY r.resolutionId DESC LIMIT 10

## 4. 데이터 소스 매핑
    
    ### 4.1 Resolution 매핑
    
    **소스**: Final Report 본문
    
    | 관계 | 소스 | 변환 규칙 |
    | --- | --- | --- |
    | references → Tdoc | content 내 참조 | `R2-\\d{7}` 패턴 추출 |
    | madeAt → Meeting | 문서 메타 | 파일명에서 회의 번호 추출 후 Phase-1 Meeting의 `canonicalMeetingNumber`와 매칭 |
    | resolutionBelongsTo → AgendaItem | 섹션 헤더 | Agenda 번호 추출. **같은 미팅 내의 AgendaItem과 매칭** (madeAt으로 결정된 Meeting의 AgendaItem) |
    | hasTable → Table | content 내 참조 | `Table X.Y.Z-N` 패턴 → 같은 미팅 내 TBL 인스턴스 연결 |
    
    > TDoc 패턴: `R2-\\d{7}`
    
    **references → Tdoc 매칭 실패 시 처리 규칙:**
    
    | 조건 | 처리 |
    | --- | --- |
    | 추출된 Tdoc 번호가 Phase-1 인스턴스에 존재 | 기존 인스턴스에 references 관계 생성 |
    | 추출된 Tdoc 번호가 Phase-1 인스턴스에 없음 (다른 WG 문서 등) | references 관계 생성 안 함 + 로그 기록 |
    
    *참고: Resolution 본문에서 추출된 `R2-\\d{7}` 패턴이 Phase-1 Tdoc 인스턴스에 존재하지 않을 수 있음. 이 경우 동적 생성하지 않고 관계를 생략함*

same_WG_original_approval_lookup_context.question_en: List the TDocs approved or agreed at meeting RAN2#131 (meeting outcome review).
same_WG_original_approval_lookup_context.cypher: MATCH (m:Meeting {canonicalMeetingNumber: 'RAN2#131'})<-[:PRESENTED_AT]-(t:Tdoc) WHERE t.status IN ['approved', 'agreed'] RETURN t.tdocNumber, t.title, t.type, t.status ORDER BY t.tdocNumber ASC LIMIT 10

same_WG_context_role: Companion CQ is contextual contrast only. Its explicit approved/agreed pair does not exclude endorsed from the current CQ, whose own approval relation is the requested role.
counterauthority: Current own CQ4-2 asks approval trace; Phase1 status vocabulary calls endorsed support/approval and conditionally agreed conditional agreement. Actual same-CR Agreed-in-principle/Endorsed source outcomes demonstrate why approved/agreed alone is insufficient. Original REFERENCES is broad content-derived metadata, so status alone is not an assertion that every returned helper CR pair was approved by that Resolution.
direct_source_event_authority: Current approved-the-CRs role is tied to the source event in the recorded Resolution content. A later revised status neither erases a directly Endorsed event nor proves an old revision was approved by this Resolution.
